Property.name: SuccessEmailSubject
Property.Description: This is the subject to use on the success email

Property.name: SucessEmailBody
Property.Description: Email This is the body that will be included in the success email

Property.name: FailureEmailSubject
Property.Description: This is the subject to use on the failure email

Property.name: FailureEmailBody
Property.Description: Email This is the body that will be included in the failure email

Property.name: Filename
Property.Description:
Name of file to output the document(s) to. May include timestamp specifiers. The %f specifier if present will be replaced with the name of the document's original source filename (stripped of characters illegal in target filenames).

See the method Ens.Util.File.CreateTimestamp() for documentation of timestamping options.

Property.name: TempFilename
Property.Description: Name of a temporary file to output the document(s) to. Upon completion of the upload the file with this name to the FTP server it is renIamed to the name specified in the Filename setting. If this setting is blank no temporary file will be used.<p/> May include timestamp specifiers. The %f specifier if present will be replaced with the name of the document's original source filename (stripped of characters illegal in target filenames).<p/> See the method Ens.Util.File.CreateTimestamp() for documentation of timestamping options.

Method.name: OnMessage
Method.Implementation: Quit:'$IsObject(pRequest.Stream) $$$ERROR($$$EnsErrGeneral,"No Stream contained in StreamContainer Request") $$$LOGINFO("Calling Super class") Set tFileName="" set tSC = ##super(pRequest,pResponse) $$$LOGINFO("Current Retry Count : "_..RetryCount) set MaxRetry = (..FailureTimeout/..RetryInterval)+1 $$$LOGINFO(..FailureTimeout_" **** "_..RetryInterval_" ***** "_"Max retry : "_MaxRetry) //If the Filename in setting is %F then get the Filename If ..Filename = "%f" { Set tFileName = ##class(%File).GetFilename(pRequest.OriginalFilename) _ " " } If $$$ISOK(tSC) { $$$LOGINFO("Sending alert for successful file transfer.") ;set alert.AlertText=$$$ITFCOMMONSendEmailOnSuccess _ ":emailSubject: "_..EmailSubject_" emailBody:"_..EmailBody do ..ItfSendEmailOnSuccess(tFileName_..SuccessEmailSubject, tFileName_..SucessEmailBody) } ElseIf(..RetryCount=MaxRetry) { $$$LOGINFO("Sending alert for failure in file transfer.") ;set alert.AlertText=$$$ITFCOMMONSendEmailOnSuccess _ ":emailSubject: "_..EmailSubject_" emailBody:"_..EmailBody do ..ItfSendEmailOnError(tFileName_..FailureEmailSubject, tFileName_..FailureEmailBody) } Quit tSC
